data.name: LEKANO WORLD ONLINE
data.detailed_description:
You can jump into the Steam Playtest right now and try the arena combat for yourself.
Feel the movement, switch between Lekamons, get into the rhythm of the fight - and just have a great time.

There are still plenty of rough edges, and we're fully aware of them.
We're working on fixes every single day.

But one thing already stands out:
the hundreds of unique animations for every Lekamon - in all directions, states, and situations - already deliver the feeling we've been building toward.
It shows how carefully and passionately we work on this game.

Join the Playtest, try the arena -
and share your thoughts in our Discord!

If you grew up loving creature-collecting games, this one is going to hit you harder than anything else.

When we were kids, we dreamed about worlds where you could travel with creatures, make new friends, fight, explore floating islands, and feel like every adventure truly belonged to you.

But then we grew up.
And the genre... didn't.

We waited for it to become deeper.
For the stories to become braver.
For the creatures to feel alive.
For our choices to actually matter.
For the world to be more than a pretty picture -
to feel like a place you could live in.

LEKANO WORLD ONLINE is for everyone who ever wanted "that experience"...
but more mature, more honest, and far more emotional.

This is a world that once shined with magic, music, and light.
A world where humans and Lekamons lived side by side.
A world that was shattered - and now survives on one last fragment of hope.

You are a Lekanit, a soul called from another world.
Not a hero in the classic sense.
But the last spark capable of restoring the bond between ancient magic and the creatures who forgot what family feels like.

Here, you will:

🔻 Meet Lekamons who grew up in fear and constant survival - and desperately need your help.
🔻 Go on expeditions where every victory brings loot, and every defeat comes with real loss.
🔻 Dive into a Lekamon's body using the power of Leitana, leaving your own body vulnerable.
🔻 Fight in PvP arenas, proving that connection is stronger than brute force.
🔻 Restore broken islands, bringing life back to a dying world.

LEKANO WORLD ONLINE is the game you always wished the genre would grow into - but never got.

More emotional.
More mature.
More honest.
More alive.

This isn't a remake of someone else's idea.
This is a new path.
And you're standing right at the beginning of it.

Gather your team.
Restore the light of the Lekrist.
And become the one who truly can change this world.



LEKANO WORLD ONLINE combines three genres into one cohesive, deeply engaging experience:

🔻 Creature-Collecting Action RPG
Catch, train, and unlock new forms of Lekamons - creatures with their own personalities, lore, and even their own language, Leklian, which you'll learn to understand as you grow closer to them and unlock unique mechanics.

🔻 Arena Shooter / Tactical PvP
Fast-paced team battles where you dive directly into a Lekamon's body. Victory depends on reaction, synergy, and strategy - and on the strength of your unique Lekamon, not random chance.

🔻 Co-op Extraction Adventure in an Open World
Dangerous expeditions to shattered islands - solo or with friends.
Every victory brings valuable loot,
and every defeat can cost you everything.
Explore ruins, hunt wild Lekamons, avoid Vorla,
and make it back home alive.

🔻 This isn't just a blend of genres - it's a new kind of creature-collecting game.
A living world, real emotion, real risk, real bonds with your Lekamons - and every decision truly matters.

English*, French, German, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
*languages with full audio support
